subject: Nobody got paid today
body: Payroll was approved Tuesday. It's Friday and not one employee has the deposit. The run page just says submitted. What is going on?

subject: 401k didn't come out of Maria's check
body: Maria signed up for 5% to the 401(k) last month. Her paycheck today has no 401k deduction at all, just taxes.

subject: Can't see my W-2
body: I'm an employee. The invite email to the Tallyroll portal says the link has expired, so I can't get in to download my W-2 for my taxes.

subject: Why are we paying for 12 people?
body: We were charged $412 by Tallyroll this month. We only have 6 employees on payroll. Please explain the bill.

subject: Payroll missing in QuickBooks
body: The last two payrolls ran fine, but the journal entries never showed up in QuickBooks Online. Our accountant is closing the month.

subject: IRS says we owe a penalty
body: Got a CP136 letter and a separate notice saying we owe a penalty for the second quarter 941. We pay Tallyroll to handle taxes, so why is this happening?

subject: Checks way too small this week
body: Half the kitchen staff got paid for zero hours. Their hours are in Homebase, but they came over to Tallyroll as zeros. Can you fix the import?

subject: Wrong state tax after move
body: Sam moved from Indiana to Ohio in June and updated his address. His checks still take Indiana tax and nothing for Ohio.

subject: Bonus check took 401k
body: Our plan says bonuses are not eligible for 401(k) contributions, but the bonus run took 6% from everyone's bonus.

subject: Need to pay a new hire for last week
body: We forgot to add a new hire before the run closed. She worked 32 hours last week. Can we pay her today without waiting two weeks?

subject: Two-factor code never arrives
body: The text with my login code never comes. I've tried five times. It's payday and I'm the only admin.

subject: Refund for the month we were closed
body: Our restaurant was closed all of August for renovation and we ran no payroll. Can we get the August subscription fee back?

subject: Health insurance deduction doubled
body: Everyone's medical deduction on this check is twice the usual amount. Did the plan premium change, or is it a mistake?

subject: Hourly rate raise not applied
body: I gave Leo a raise from $18 to $21 an hour starting this period. His check today still paid $18.

subject: Xero says invalid token
body: Every time Tallyroll tries to post to Xero we get invalid_grant. I reconnected once and it worked for a day.

subject: Corrected W-2 for wrong wages
body: Our 2025 W-2 for Alicia shows $48,200 in wages, but she was paid $45,800. The bonus we reversed is still on it. She needs a corrected form.

subject: Remove access for our old accountant
body: We changed accounting firms. Please make sure the old firm's login can't see anything in our account anymore.

subject: Card declined on our subscription
body: We got a warning that the account will be suspended because the payment failed. I updated the card, but how do I retry the charge?

subject: Direct deposit went to old account
body: An employee changed banks and updated it in the portal last week, but today's pay went to her closed account.

subject: PTO balance wrong after policy change
body: We changed the PTO policy to 15 days a year in July. Everyone's balance in Tallyroll still accrues at 10 days.

subject: Developer can't create webhooks
body: Our engineer gets a 403 when calling POST /v1/webhooks with the API key we made last week. Reading employees works.

subject: Do we need to register in Georgia?
body: We hired a sales rep who will work from home in Atlanta. What state tax accounts do we need before her first paycheck?

subject: Give our store managers limited access
body: I want each store manager to approve hours for their own store only and not see anyone's pay. Which role does that?

subject: Pay stub shows wrong pay period
body: Today's pay stubs say the period is the 1st to the 15th of last month. It should be this month. Employees are confused.

subject: Downgrade to the basic plan
body: We don't use the HR tools in Plus. What happens if we move back to the basic plan, and when does the price change?

subject: New hire wants to join the health plan
body: Our new hire started Monday and wants medical and dental. Can she enrol herself in the portal or do I have to add her?

subject: Hours imported to the wrong pay period
body: When I Work sent this week's hours into the pay period that already closed, so the current run shows no hours.

subject: 1099 sent to an employee by mistake
body: One of our W-2 employees also got a 1099-NEC from Tallyroll for $600 in expense reimbursements. She shouldn't have a 1099.

subject: Final paycheck for a terminated employee
body: We let someone go today in Massachusetts. I need to pay his last wages and accrued vacation today. How do I do that in Tallyroll?

subject: Locked out, owner is on vacation
body: I'm the office manager. My account got locked and the owner who can unlock it is away for two weeks. Payroll is due Thursday.

subject: Invoice addressed to the wrong company name
body: Our Tallyroll invoices still show our old company name from before we rebranded. Our finance team needs them to match the new legal name.

subject: COBRA for an employee who left in May
body: A former employee says she never got her COBRA paperwork. She left in May. Who sends it and can it still be sent?

subject: QuickBooks shows wages twice
body: After we reconnected QuickBooks, last month's payroll posted a second time, so our wage expense is doubled.

subject: Employee wants extra withholding
body: An employee asked to have an extra $50 of federal tax taken out of each check. Where do I enter that?

subject: Overtime missing for a salaried nonexempt employee
body: Dana is salaried but nonexempt. She worked 50 hours last week and the check didn't pay any overtime.

subject: Employee locked out of the app
body: Several of our drivers can't log in to the Tallyroll mobile app to see their pay. It says their account is disabled.

subject: Charged after we cancelled
body: We cancelled Tallyroll in September and moved to another provider, but there is another $96 charge from you this month.

subject: HSA employer contribution
body: We want to put $50 a month into each employee's HSA. How do we add a company contribution that isn't taken from their pay?

subject: Gusto to Tallyroll employee import failed
body: We're switching to Tallyroll. The CSV import of our employees from Gusto stops at row 12 with 'unknown column pay_basis'.

subject: Ohio sent a notice about unpaid tax
body: Ohio says our withholding for August was never paid. Your dashboard shows it as filed. We need to know what happened before the late fees grow.

subject: Approved payroll by mistake
body: I approved this week's payroll with the wrong hours for two people. It hasn't been paid yet. Can I cancel it and run it again?

subject: SSO stopped working after we moved to Okta
body: We moved from Google to Okta for logins. Now nobody can sign in to Tallyroll with single sign-on.

subject: Do contractors count toward our fee?
body: We pay 20 contractors through Tallyroll but only 4 employees. Are we being charged the per-person fee for the contractors too?

subject: Dependent added to vision plan
body: An employee added his son to the vision plan, but his deduction still shows employee-only. The insurer says the son is covered.

subject: Tallyroll API pagination
body: The /v1/employees endpoint only gives us 100 records and we have 140 people. How do we get the next page?

subject: State unemployment account number missing
body: Tallyroll keeps showing a red banner that our Florida reemployment tax account number is missing. We applied but haven't heard back.

subject: Tips not on the paycheck
body: We entered credit card tips for the servers in the run, but the checks didn't include them. The tips line is empty on the stubs.

subject: Add a second admin
body: I'm the only person who can run payroll. I want our operations lead to have full admin access as a backup.

subject: Need a W-9 from Tallyroll
body: Our accounts payable team needs Tallyroll's W-9 before they can keep paying your invoices. Can you send one?

subject: Retirement contribution limit
body: A senior employee will hit the 401(k) annual limit in October. Will Tallyroll stop the deduction automatically?

subject: Time clock hours not syncing for one location
body: Our Austin store's hours from the Homebase time clock aren't syncing, but the Dallas store's are. Same Homebase account.

subject: Wrong FUTA credit reduction
body: Our 940 preview shows a credit reduction for California, but we have no employees in California. We are only in Nevada.

subject: Payroll is late again
body: This is the second time this quarter the deposits came a day late. We run payroll four days ahead. Our staff are upset.

subject: Wrong email on my admin login
body: My login is under my old work email, which I can't get into anymore. How do I change the email on my admin account?

subject: Can we pay by ACH instead of card?
body: Our finance team would like to pay the Tallyroll subscription by bank transfer instead of the company card. Is that possible?

subject: Sick leave not accruing in New Jersey
body: New Jersey requires one hour of sick leave for every 30 hours. Our NJ employees show zero sick hours after three months.

subject: Payroll webhook delivered twice
body: Our endpoint gets every payroll.completed event twice, a few seconds apart, so our system creates two expense records.

subject: Local tax for a remote employee in Pennsylvania
body: A remote employee lives in Pittsburgh. Do we need to withhold the local earned income tax, and why isn't Tallyroll doing it?

subject: Garnishment amount wrong
body: We got a court order to withhold $200 per check for child support from one employee, but the run took $400.

subject: Accountant needs read-only access
body: Our CPA wants to log in and pull reports at year end. I don't want her able to change anything or approve payroll.

subject: Something is off with Jake's pay
body: Jake says his check is smaller than it should be this time. Can someone look at it? He's not happy.

subject: Payroll numbers don't match
body: The payroll total in Tallyroll and the number our accountant sees are different by about $3,000 for September. Which one is right?

subject: Letter from the state
body: We got a letter from the state about our account. I'm attaching a photo. I don't really understand what they want us to do.

subject: Can't approve payroll
body: The approve button is grey and I can't click it. Payroll has to go out today. Please help ASAP.

subject: What is this charge?
body: There's a $58 charge from Tallyroll on our bank statement on the 20th that I don't recognise. We already paid this month.

subject: Employee says she was underpaid
body: One of our nurses says she was paid for 72 hours but worked 80. Her timesheet in Tallyroll shows 80.

subject: Hours wrong for everyone
body: Every employee's hours look wrong in this run. Some have double, some have none. We didn't change anything on our side.

subject: Deduction question
body: Why is there a new deduction on everyone's stub called SEC125? Nobody here set that up.

subject: New employee in another state
body: We're hiring someone who'll live in New Jersey and come into our New York office twice a week. Anything we need to do before she starts?

subject: Our account looks different
body: I logged in today and I can't find the payroll tab anymore, or the reports. Did something change in Tallyroll?

subject: Closing the business
body: We're closing at the end of the year. What do we need to do with Tallyroll, and what will we still owe?

subject: Urgent payroll problem
body: Please call me as soon as possible about this week's payroll. My number is on the account.
